## Opponent Reads

**Player 2**: **LAG/maniac, extreme calling station postflop. Consistent chip leader across sessions.** 3-bets extremely wide (mid pairs, trash). Calls down with virtually anything. **As PFA**: c-bets flop then checks/folds turn when called — profitable float spot. Checks flop then bets turn = delayed value (real hand). **As caller**: Check-calls flop, DONK-LEADS turn with real hands/draws, then checks river and calls all-ins with top pair weak kicker. **Exploit**: 3-bet for value. Value bet EXTREMELY thin. Do NOT bluff. Float flop c-bets. Turn donk-leads (as non-PFA) = real hands.

**Player 3**: **Selectively aggressive, skilled. Consistent mid-table finisher.** Opens and 4-bets wider than premium (suited aces as semi-bluffs). 3-bets from SB vs late-position steals. **Confirmed trapper** — check-calls multiple streets with two pair+. River checks can be traps. Folds dry boards without connections. **Exploit**: C-bet dry boards. Turn leads after flop checks = completed draw. Don't value-bet thin on river. Can call wider vs 4-bets. Tighten steals when P3 in blinds.

**Player 4**: **Wide VPIP (~47%), passive preflop, capable of BIG river aggression with weak hands.** Limps weak, raises better. Limp-reraise = strong (99+). Shoves AA preflop. **River shoves do NOT always = strength** — confirmed shoved with bottom pair. EXTREMELY sticky — calls river with 9-high. **Exploit**: Isolate limps with position. Value bet EXTREMELY wide — #1 value target. NEVER bluff. Respect check-raises, donk-bets, limp-reraises. Call river shoves lighter than default.

**Player 5**: **Nit (~8-10% VPIP).** Any preflop raise = strong. **Four lines**: (1) Single donk-bet then folds to raises/turn barrels — two-barrel bluff. (2) Donk-bet + shove = strong draw. (3) Multi-street barreling = nutted (FOLD without nuts). (4) Passive calling = weak, can triple-barrel. **Exploit**: Two-barrel bluff line 1. FOLD to multi-street aggression. Triple-barrel passive mode.

**Player 6**: **Tight raiser (~9%), wide limper/caller. Consistent loser.** 3-bets = QQ+/AK. Cold 4-bets = AA/KK. C-bets flop then folds to turn donk-leads. **KEY WEAKNESS**: Folds QQ/KK on ace-high boards. Folds to sustained double-barrels. **Exploit**: Fold to 3-bets/4-bets. Isolate limps freely. Bluff ace-high/scary boards. Double-barrel. Call barrels lighter (overvalues medium pairs).

**Player 7**: **Wider than TAG — calls broadways, wide from blinds.** Passive preflop, AGGRESSIVE postflop — donk-leads and double-barrels with strength. Raises flop with just top pair on paired boards (spewy). Once committed, calls down with one pair. **Exploit**: Value bet relentlessly when ahead. Don't bluff once they've shown aggression.

## My Table Image & Discipline

**Image after 3 sessions**: Ultra-tight. ZERO showdowns across all sessions — every win has been fold equity. Opponents have literally no data on my actual holdings. Image is MAXIMALLY credible for steals and bluffs.

**Image leverage opportunity**: Can profitably open wider from steal positions and semi-bluff more. Successfully stole with 76o and A4cc this session — confirming image is highly exploitable in my favor. Should push this edge further before opponents adjust.

**Confirmed leaks**:
1. **Offsuit broadways (KJo, KQo type)**: Lost $30 with KJo this session. These hands play poorly postflop in raised pots. FOLD KJo facing raises; only open from late position.
2. **Weak aces (A2-AT offsuit)**: Repeatedly losing small amounts. FOLD unless stealing or suited.
3. **Mid pairs invested then abandoned**: Fold small/mid pairs without set-mining conditions.

## Core Strategy

1. **VPIP target: 20-25%.** Achieved 20% this session — good discipline. All profit came from steals/fold equity.
2. **Hand selection**: Premiums (TT+, AJ+, KQs) for value. Suited connectors/small pairs ONLY in position vs limpers. ATs+ from steal positions. FOLD KJo/KQo facing raises. FOLD weak aces.
3. **Maximize fold equity**: Zero-showdown win rate is sustainable short-term but need to win bigger pots at showdown eventually. Look for thin value spots vs stations (P2, P4).
4. **Station exploit (P2, P4, P7)**: Value bet wide, NEVER bluff, isolate limps.
5. **P5 (nit)**: Two-barrel bluff single donk-bets. FOLD to multi-street aggression.
6. **P6 (exploitable)**: Bluff ace-high/scary boards. Double-barrel. Fold to preflop aggression.
7. **P3 (skilled)**: Tighten steals. Don't thin value-bet rivers (traps).
8. **Threat hierarchy**: P3 (skilled) > P2 (LAG volume) > P4 (station + spewy) > P7 (spewy) > P6 (exploitable) > P5 (nit).
